test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

The interviewer asked me if I could drive a car.

options.text: The interviewer said, "Will you drive a car?"
The interviewer said, "Can you drive a car?
The interviewer said, "You can drive a car."
The interviewer said, "Shall | drive a car?"

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The interviewer asked me if I could drive a car.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if I could drive" becomes "Can you drive"**
